capacity.why_no_exact_reclaim: ThinLV data_percent includes shared blocks; inactiveLvs have no percent, and logical provisionedcapacity is not freeablephysicalspace. No thin metadata activation/dump/trim performed.

limitations: Disk/header/UUID metadata only; no guest datafile read, and no proof that older or231/232userdisks contain no neededfiles.
No gueststart/stop/delete/backup, no qcow repair/rebase/convert/resize, no LVM remove/activate/trim, no CFguestexec.
Some stoppedLVMbase LVdevice paths absent becauseinactive; lvs metadata existence is authoritative, not a missingdisk declaration.
RootFS UUID is shared across several clones and must not be used asunique VMidentity or deletion ownership.
Directory qemu-img -U observations can race writes; parent rechecks exactrefs/snapshots/backing immediately before deletion.
PVE-only backups sharehost faultdomain and are not independent disaster recovery.
Cleanup software/ACL/scrape/IPregistry/budget updates are parent followup, not performed by audit.
user_cleanup_authorization: Parent reports explicit cleanup authorization; auditor remains read-only, Java each1 details are still parent clarification gate.
